title: HELLDIVERS II Ping Wheel Icon & SFX
description: Replaces Ping Wheel’s default sound and icon with those from HELLDIVERS II
body:
Bring a little bit of _Managed Democracy_ into your Minecraft world.
This resource pack swaps the standard Ping Wheel **sound** and **icon** with ones from **HELLDIVERS II**.

## Requirement:

- [Ping Wheel](https://modrinth.com/mod/ping-wheel) This pack will **_not_** function without it.
 
## Versions:

This pack comes in 3 variants so you can pick what suits you best:

- HD2 Quick Mark SFX + Icon
- HD2 Map Mark SFX + Icon
- HD2 Icon Only

Below is an example video:

## Credits:

- Original audio and design created by **Arrowhead Game Studios** and **PlayStation Studios** for **HELLDIVERS II**
- I did **not** create the sounds or icon; this pack only **repackages** them for Ping Wheel
- Please support the original developers and respect their work
